summary: End-to-end ML platforms unify data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring into managed workflows that scale across clusters and GPUs. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require governance, reproducibility, and production serving at scale; if you only consume a pre-trained foundation model, a hosted model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is usually simpler and cheaper. The market is led by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and Databricks, with specialized MLOps and AutoML players clustering below them.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hours, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams wanting a fully managed, service-oriented ML lifecycle at scale.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction compute, node-hours, and token usage for generative models.
platforms.best_for: Teams on GCP wanting unified AutoML plus access to Gemini and foundation models.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hours and managed endpoint usage; no platform surcharge beyond compute.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and responsible AI tooling.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based via Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute.
platforms.best_for: Unified data lakehouse + ML teams wanting multi-cloud portability and open MLflow.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; paid per-seat/usage-based tiers for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Business and analytics teams wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise platform via subscription licensing.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable AI at scale.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing of CPU/GPU compute; pay only for runtime.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless Python-native GPU infrastructure for training and inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; paid Pro, Inference Endpoints (compute-based), and enterprise plans.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformers and foundation models with easy deployment.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open-source; cost is underlying Kubernetes infrastructure and ops.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps without vendor lock-in.
